messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — we have a subset of new onboarding flows that experienced tokenization failures between 08:12-08:28 UTC. Affects ~12 trial tenants and a handful of northstar POCs. OpsBot: Incident INC-2024-561 created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2024-561 :rotating_light:
Liam O'Reilly: thanks for flagging. Do we know impact on data import/jobs? need to tell customers asap. :eyes:
Helga Nguyen: root cause: a model tokenizer edge-case after an update to the tokenizer Lib v1.8.2. We deployed a rollback at 08:25 which stopped new failures. Retro notes incoming.
Sanjay Patel: good to know rollback worked. Any partial data loss for affected imports?
Helga Nguyen: no data loss — some requests returned 5xx and were dropped. We captured IDs for retry; engineering will queue retries for confirmed tenants.
Maya Chen: proposed customer comm: short status update + apology + mitigation + offer 1 month free credits for trials and a dedicated office hour for high-touch accounts. Draft below — please edit:
Maya Chen: "Hi Alice (Acct Team),
We experienced an error during onboarding that may have blocked document ingestion for your trial between 08:12–08:28 UTC. We've fixed the issue and retried affected uploads; if you still see missing docs, please reply and we'll re-run immediately. As an apology, we credited your account with 1 month of platform usage and offer a 1:1 troubleshooting session. — Redwood CS"
Ava Ramos: wording looks good. can we add explicit CTA to check the ingestion status in the tenant dashboard?
Maya Chen: yes adding: "Check: Console > Onboarding > Import History"
Liam O'Reilly: recommend we prioritize 4 accounts flagged as renewal-risk (IDs: R-2203, R-2261, R-2288, R-2299). For those, please escalate to AE with a direct note + offer office hours this week.
Sanjay Patel: I'll prepare the credit and manual retry for those 4. Also suggest a short FAQ and a troubleshooting doc snippet we can paste into messages.
Maya Chen: Can product/eng confirm the retry queue ETA? Helga?
Helga Nguyen: ETA for queued retries: within 2 hours for the high-priority tenants; bulk retries starting in 4 hours. We'll monitor and post status to the incident page.
Maya Chen: OK — final action items: 1) Liam/Ava send targeted messages to the 4 renewal-risk accounts within 1 hour; 2) Sanjay run manual retries and apply credits; 3) Helga monitors queue and updates INC-2024-561; 4) I will send the broader status email to the remaining affected trials. Approve? :thumbsup:
Liam O'Reilly: Approve. I'll coordinate with AEs and paste message in thread when sent.
Sanjay Patel: On it. I'll link the retry job IDs when started.
Helga Nguyen: Monitoring — will update incident with logs and RCA draft later today.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — please react when done. I'll craft the final outbound messages once I see the AE sends.
OpsBot: Reminder: incident INC-2024-561 status changed to "Investigating → Mitigated" at 08:30 UTC.
Maya Chen: Sending outbound at 09:00 UTC unless objections. No objections — sending. :sparkles:
